claims.statement: Guidde records a process, turns it into a step-by-step video guide, adds captions and voice, and supports links plus video, presentation, and PDF exports on paid plans.
Free supports 25 guides. Pro costs $19 per creator monthly billed annually or $29 monthly. Business costs $39 annually or $59 monthly. The Business trial lasts seven days.
Faster guide creation, an easy interface, annotations, and shareable output are the strongest positive themes.
Robotic AI voices and customization limits appear as recurring complaints.
Concern about the depth of human support appears in a smaller editorial and user subset.

scoreRationale.onboarding: Recording the first guide should be fast; accuracy, redaction, voice, and maintenance determine production value.
scoreRationale.product: Good for repeatable software walkthroughs, not a full video editor or automatic source of truth.
scoreRationale.support: Evidence is mixed and no support request was tested.
scoreRationale.billing: Viewer access is free, but paid creator seats, Business gates, and voice or avatar add-ons can raise cost.
scoreRationale.overall: Guidde is useful when a team publishes many short software guides and assigns owners to update them. Re-record a changed workflow before buying.

conflictsAndUnknowns: AI speeds the first version while voice and final customization can still need manual work.
A guide is easy to publish and easy to let go stale.
